Why We Built TECHTIS

Every day, millions of students, legal professionals, accountants, and individuals need to perform everyday document tasks: merge two invoices, extract a page from a contract, crop a passport photo, or compress a PDF for an application portal.

Historically, online document converters have operated on expensive, insecure cloud architectures: you upload your confidential files to their servers, wait in a processing queue, and download a copy, hoping they truly delete your data afterward.

TECHTIS (techtis.in) changes that paradigm. Modern web browsers are astonishingly powerful computing environments. By harnessing client-side WebAssembly, HTML5 Canvas, and modern Web Workers, we deliver 40 professional-grade document and image utilities that execute entirely in your browser's local RAM.

The Technology Stack

Our platform is built upon rock-solid, open-source client-side technologies:

  • PDF Engine: In-browser PDF-Lib and PDF.js for binary object reconstruction, stream compression, and vector rendering.
  • Image & Canvas Engine: Hardware-accelerated HTML5 Canvas with bicubic resampling for high-DPI image scaling, format conversion, and cropping.
  • Private OCR: In-browser WebAssembly Tesseract.js for zero-network text recognition and automated Indian Aadhaar/PAN card parsing.
  • Zero-Cost Architecture: Static hosting on Cloudflare Edge guarantees 99.99% uptime, zero carbon waste, and instant global availability.
